relics.name: Amphibian Boot
relics.description:
+1 experience point for each second of acceleration from the «Fins» ability.
+1 experience point for every second of acceleration from the «Slipping» ability.
relics.note: Swim and rain speed; air saving is the stronger part.

abilities.name: Fins
abilities.description: Increases swimming speed by %1$s%% per second of swimming. The modifier stops increasing if the swimming duration exceeds %2$s seconds.

abilities.name: Slipping
abilities.description: Increases movement speed in the rain by %1$s%% per second of movement. The modifier stops increasing if the duration of movement in the rain exceeds %2$s seconds.

abilities.name: Gills
abilities.description: With a %1$s%% chance, the player may not consume an air unit while swimming or in other conditions.

relics.name: Aqua Walker
relics.description: +1 experience point for every 5 units of getting wet from the ability «Moisture Resistance».
relics.note: Walk on water for a while.

abilities.name: Moisture Resistance
abilities.description: For a certain period, allows walking on the surface of water without sinking. Once the time runs out, the boots start sinking, pulling the wearer underwater. To dry them, the wearer must stay away from water blocks. The drying time fully depends on the level of saturation.

relics.name: Arcane Batteries
relics.description: Fully charged. Mostly.
relics.note: Terminux. Flat max mana; grows steadily from Common.

abilities.name: Charged Cells
abilities.description: Increases max mana by %1$s.

relics.name: Arcane Gloves
relics.description: Soft enough to waste nothing.
relics.note: Terminux. Mana cost reduction; grows steadily from Common.

abilities.name: Mana Economy
abilities.description: Spells cost %1$s%% less mana.

relics.name: Azure Pendant
relics.description: A cold stone that remembers every spell cast near it.
relics.note: Terminux. Percent max mana; grows steadily from Common.

abilities.name: Deep Reservoir
abilities.description: Increases max mana by %1$s%%.

relics.name: Bastion Ring
relics.description:
+1/5/10 experience point for each killed Zombified Piglin / Piglin / Piglin Brute.
+1 experience point for each additional trade from the ability «Respect».
relics.note: Piglin peace early, the trade bonus later.

abilities.name: Recognition
abilities.description: Makes piglins neutral in relation to the wearer. The nearest piglin will indicate the location of a bastion nearby.

abilities.name: Respect
abilities.description: Each trade with piglins has a multiple 50% chance to yield an additional trade result, but the chance cannot trigger more than %1$s times.

relics.name: Broken Mirror
relics.description: ...does it still work?
relics.note: Has no abilities.

relics.name: Chorus Inhibitor
relics.description: +1 experience point for every 10 blocks to the teleportation point from the «Teleportation Control» ability.
relics.note: Aimed chorus fruit teleport.

abilities.name: Teleportation Control
abilities.description: Using a chorus fruit teleports the wearer to a block along the line of sight within %1$s blocks, then goes on cooldown for %2$s seconds.

relics.name: Crowbar
relics.description: Deal bonus damage to enemies above 90% health.
relics.note: Up to +600% damage against targets above 90% health.

abilities.name: Heavy Hitter
abilities.description: When the holder attacks an enemy that has more than 90% of its health remaining, they deal %1$s%% more damage

abilities.name: Pry It Open!
abilities.description: This item can instabreak planks

relics.name: Deer Antler
relics.description: A suspiciously large antler for an ordinary deer, which would look just as suspiciously fitting on some living creature.
relics.note: Carry creatures on your antlers; the size limit reaches 2,048 blocks at max.

abilities.name: On the Horns!
abilities.description: When used on a creature whose hitbox volume does not exceed %1$s blocks, places it on the player's antlers and prevents it from dealing damage to the player.

relics.name: Depleted Spool
relics.description: Once able to regenerate threads that could alter reality, this spool has lost its power. Now silent and empty, it stands as a relic of forgotten potential.
relics.note: Broken form. Restored with string and Regeneration potions into the Weavers Spool.

abilities.name: Restoration
abilities.description: The spool's powers can be restored by holding the required items while wearing it, reawakening its ability to regenerate reality-altering threads.

relics.name: Drowned Belt
relics.description: +1 experience point for each level of enchantment «Riptide» on the trident when using it.
relics.note: Same slot progression as the Leather Belt, plus underwater damage and Riptide anywhere.

abilities.name: Load Capacity
abilities.description: Increases the maximum number of amulet equipment slots by +%1$s.

abilities.name: Dead Weight
abilities.description: Reduces swimming speed by %1$s%% and increases the wearer's sinking speed by %1$s%%.

abilities.name: Water Flows
abilities.description: Increases the damage dealt by the player underwater by %1$s%%.

abilities.name: Water Attraction
abilities.description: Allows the trident's «Riptide» enchantment ability to be used without rain or water, adding a cooldown of %1$s seconds per enchantment level.

relics.name: Eject Button
relics.description: A yellow box with a red, glowing button. Engineered for "heroic and tactical" retreats.
relics.note: Speed burst at low health.

abilities.name: Nope
abilities.description: Grants %1$sX speed when the user's health is low.

relics.name: Ender Hand
relics.description: +1 experience point for using the ability «End Transposition», +1 experience point for every 10 blocks from the distance to the target when using.
relics.note: Endermen peace early, the swap later.

abilities.name: Neutrality
abilities.description: Makes endermen neutral to the wearer.

abilities.name: End Transposition
abilities.description: Swaps the user and the target along the line of sight within a range of up to %1$s blocks.

relics.name: Energy Drink
relics.description: Increases your sprinting speed!
relics.note: Sprint speed +25% up to +275%.

abilities.name: Speed Boost
abilities.description: Sprint speed is improved by %1$s%%

relics.name: Firefly Queen
relics.description: A fragile and slightly disgusting-looking insect capable of spawning a swarm of fireflies that will forever dispel any darkness.
relics.note: Light in the dark.

abilities.name: Glowkeeper
abilities.description: Generates a firefly larva in the internal buffer every %1$s seconds, with a maximum of %2$s at a time. When the player is in complete darkness, it consumes 1 larva and places a firefly nearby to light the way.

relics.name: Hubris Hourglass
relics.description: Every grain is a lesson. Every lesson draws blood.
relics.note: Terminux trinket, Common. More experience of every kind (orbs, skill tree, relic experience), more damage taken.

abilities.name: Hubris
abilities.description: You gain %1$s%% more experience: orbs, skill tree experience and relic experience. You take %2$s%% more damage from every source.

relics.name: Hunter Belt
relics.description: +1 experience point for each attack made by the wearer's pet.
relics.note: Same slot progression as the Leather Belt, plus pet damage, so it is never weaker.

abilities.name: Load Capacity
abilities.description: Increases the maximum number of amulet equipment slots by +%1$s.

abilities.name: training
abilities.description: Increases the damage dealt by the wearer's pets by %1$s%%.

relics.name: Ice Breaker
relics.description: +1 experience point for every 3 blocks in the fall before triggering the ability «Earthquake».
relics.note: Knockback resistance early, the landing shockwave later.

abilities.name: Sustainability
abilities.description: Increases fall speed, boosts knockback resistance by %1$s%%, and removes sliding on blocks.

abilities.name: Earthquake
abilities.description: Prolonged use of the ability while falling, up until landing, will create a shockwave with a radius of %1$s blocks, dealing up to %2$s damage and knocking back nearby targets. However, the power of the shockwave also depends on the distance the wearer has fallen.

relics.name: Ice Skates
relics.description: +1 experience point for each second of acceleration from the ability «Skating».
relics.note: Speed on ice; Ram later.

abilities.name: Skating
abilities.description: Increases movement speed on ice by %1$s%% per second of sliding. The modifier stops increasing if the sliding duration exceeds %2$s seconds.

abilities.name: Ram
abilities.description: Upon collision with targets, deals %1$s damage per second of sliding from the «Skating» ability.

relics.name: Infinite Ham
relics.description: A mysterious piece of meat that smoothly regenerates to its original size, no matter how much you carve it.
relics.note: Endless food first. Marinade stores potion effects and is the strong part.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: Every %1$s seconds, regenerates up to 6 edible chunks, each restoring %2$s hunger points. When consumed, the relic automatically uses the required number of chunks to replenish the player's hunger.

abilities.name: Marinade
abilities.description: Allows applying potion effects to the relic by left-clicking it with a potion in the inventory. Each time the relic is consumed, it applies these effects to the player for %1$s seconds per hunger point restored. Using a water bottle clears the last applied potion effects.

abilities.name: Meat Bat
abilities.description: Allows the relic to be used as a melee weapon, dealing %1$s damage and stunning the target for %2$s seconds per chunk. Consumes all chunks when attacking, regardless of the target's remaining health.

relics.name: Invisibility Cloak
relics.description: A strange thing – stare at it long enough and it... starts vanishing? Hard to imagine why the emperor needed such a cloak...
relics.note: Hidden armor, invisibility when still.

abilities.name: Imperial Attire
abilities.description: Hides the appearance of equipped armor.

abilities.name: Camouflage
abilities.description: Grants full invisibility after remaining completely still or sneaking without interruption for at least %1$s seconds.

relics.name: Jellyfish Necklace
relics.description: +1 experience point for each activation of the ability «Electric Discharge».
relics.note: No sinking and contact shock early, paralysis later.

abilities.name: Power over the sea
abilities.description: The wearer does not sink in water.

abilities.name: Electrical Discharge
abilities.description: Deals %1$s damage to targets upon collision with them.

abilities.name: Paralysis
abilities.description: When the «Electric Discharge» ability activates, it applies paralysis to the target for %1$s seconds.

relics.name: Katana Trinket
relics.description: Great addition to your backpack!
relics.note: Sprint in any direction.

abilities.name: Agility
abilities.description: Allows the player to sprint in any direction and not slow down after attacks

relics.name: Leafy Ring [WIP]
relics.description: [WIP]
relics.note: Still in development in Relics.

relics.name: Leather Belt
relics.description: +1 experience point for each experience gained by equipped charms.
relics.note: Amulet slots from 3 to 13. Low levels stay in low rarities.

abilities.name: Load Capacity
abilities.description: Increases the maximum number of amulet equipment slots by +%1$s.

relics.name: Magic Mirror
relics.description: +1 experience point for each use of the «Wormhole» ability, +1 experience point for every 50 blocks to the teleportation point.
relics.note: Recall to spawn.

abilities.name: Wormhole
abilities.description: Upon use, teleports the owner to their spawn point if it is within %1$s blocks, then goes on cooldown for %2$s seconds.

relics.name: Magma Walker
relics.description: +1 experience point for every 5 units of heating from the ability «Fiery Tread».
relics.note: Hot block immunity early, lava walking later.

abilities.name: Heat Resistance
abilities.description: Suppresses damage from hot blocks.

abilities.name: Fiery Tread
abilities.description: For %1$s seconds, allows walking on the surface of lava without sinking or taking damage. After the time runs out, the boots start overheating and deal damage to the wearer proportional to the level of overheating. To cool them down, the wearer must stay away from lava blocks. The cooling time also depends on the level of overheating.

relics.name: Mana Syrup Bottle
relics.description: Sweet, slow and never empty. Not for drinking.
relics.note: Terminux. Out of combat mana regeneration; not a consumable.

abilities.name: Calm Flow
abilities.description: After %2$s seconds without dealing or taking damage, mana regeneration increases by %1$s%%.

relics.name: Phantom Boot
relics.description: Condenses matter beneath the relic owner's feet, creating a path through any terrain, even where no solid ground exists.
relics.note: Temporary bridges.

abilities.name: Phantom Bridge
abilities.description: Creates a temporary phantom bridge beneath the player's feet that any relic owner can walk on. If the player stands still on the bridge for more than %1$s seconds, they will fall through and cannot get back up until they reach solid ground. While sneaking, the player is forced to fall through the phantom bridge blocks.

relics.name: Roller Skates
relics.description: +1 experience point for each second of acceleration from the ability «Acceleration».
relics.note: Movement speed up to +125%.

abilities.name: Acceleration
abilities.description: Increases movement speed by %1$s%% per second of movement. The modifier stops increasing if the movement duration exceeds %2$s seconds. All blocks also become slippery for the wearer.

relics.name: Shattered Aegis
relics.description: It broke protecting someone. Now it only remembers how to strike.
relics.note: Terminux trinket, Common. Armor and magic resist become 0; each point turns into physical or spell damage.

abilities.name: Sundered Steel
abilities.description: Your armor and armor toughness are 0. Every point of armor you would have grants %1$s%% physical damage with melee and projectiles; past 60 points each counts less.

abilities.name: Sundered Ward
abilities.description: Your magic resist is 0. Every point of magic resist you would have grants %1$s%% spell damage; past 60 points each counts less.

relics.name: Soldier Syringe
relics.description:
Increase attack speed.
Do not, and I repeat, do NOT use this on a zombie.
relics.note: Attack speed +15% up to +165%.

abilities.name: Attack Speed
abilities.description: The item increases attack speed by %1$s%%

relics.name: Spirit Hand
relics.description: A gentle grip that keeps the summoned close.
relics.note: Terminux. Summon health first, damage and duration from Uncommon.

abilities.name: Spirit Vigor
abilities.description: Your summons have %1$s%% more max health.

abilities.name: Spirit Fury
abilities.description: Your summons deal %1$s%% more damage.

abilities.name: Spirit Bond
abilities.description: Your summons last %1$s%% longer.

relics.name: Springy Boot
relics.description: Grants the relic owner special elasticity, allowing them to bounce off any solid surface.
relics.note: Bouncy blocks.

abilities.name: Elasticity
abilities.description: Increases the elasticity of all blocks by %1$s%% compared to slime blocks, enabling the player to bounce off them upon landing. When activated on the ground, it launches the player into the air.

relics.name: Thorn Crown
relics.description: An ornament closely tied to torment. Its sharp thorns dig into the wearer's head, bringing both unbearable pain and paralyzing power.
relics.note: Thorn immunity and paralyzing touch.

abilities.name: Oak Skin
abilities.description: Grants the player full resistance to any 'thorn' damage.

abilities.name: Acupuncture
abilities.description: Upon touching a target, deals %3$s damage and has a %1$s%% chance to paralyze them for %2$s seconds.

relics.name: Wax Quail
relics.description: Jumping while sprinting boosts you forward.
relics.note: Forward boost on sprint jumps.

abilities.name: Woah!
abilities.description: The item grants an immediate %1$sx boost forward whenever the holder jumps while sprinting

relics.name: Wool Mitten
relics.description: +1 experience point for every 5 units of size when hit by a snowball from the ability «Mold».
relics.note: Stunning snowballs.

abilities.name: Mold
abilities.description: Collecting snow with an empty hand using RMB gradually forms special hardened snowballs, up to a size of %1$s units. Hitting a target with such a snowball deals %2$s damage, stuns for %3$s seconds, and freezes the target for %3$s per unit of snowball size. Holding a snowball in the inventory without the relic equipped also freezes the player.

relics.name: Anchor Stone
relics.description: Heavier than it looks. Much heavier.
relics.note: Terminux trinket, Uncommon. No knockback, a little slower; heavy landings make a quake.

abilities.name: Anchor
abilities.description: You cannot be knocked back, but you move %1$s%% slower.

abilities.name: Quake
abilities.description: Landing from 3 or more blocks deals %1$s damage to enemies within %2$s blocks; higher falls hit harder.

relics.name: Biojoint
relics.description: A high-tech joint implant that absorbs impact and reduces damage, providing extra protection against physical stress.
relics.note: Damage reduction up to 35%.

abilities.name: Suspension
abilities.description:
Reduces damage based on the amount taken, ranging from a maximum of %2$s% to a minimum of %1$s% reduction. The maximum reduction is achieved when the damage taken is equal to users max health or more.
While Cyberpsychosis is active: Damage reduction is always at maximum.
If multiple copies are equipped, damage reduction cannot exceed 50%.

abilities.name: Cyberpsychosis
abilities.description:
Killing an enemy has a %1$s% chance to trigger Cyberpsychosis for %2$s seconds.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.

relics.name: Bionic Eye
relics.description: A high-tech eye implant that grants the wearer the ability to seek and track targets, highlighting them even through obstacles.
relics.note: Area Vulnerability for the whole group.

abilities.name: Seeker
abilities.description:
When activated applies Glowing and Vulnerability effects on enemies in %1$s block radius for %2$s seconds. %3$s seconds cooldown.
While cyberpsychosis is active: Has reduced cooldown and applies increased Vulnerability.

abilities.name: Cyberpsychosis
abilities.description:
Killing an enemy has a %1$s% chance to trigger Cyberpsychosis for %2$s seconds.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.

relics.name: Blazing Flask
relics.description: +1 experience point for every 5 seconds of flight within the scope of the ability «Eternal Fire».
relics.note: Flight zone above fire, flight speed up to 8 blocks per second.

abilities.name: Eternal fire
abilities.description: Using the ability on a block creates a restricted flight zone with a maximum flight speed of %2$s blocks per second and a height of %3$s blocks. The area size depends on the amount of fire within a radius of %1$s blocks around the center, but if there is no fire at all, the zone will not be created.

relics.name: Bottle of Maple Syrup
relics.description: An endless syrup bottle that occasionally conjures up fresh waffles.
relics.note: Waffle regeneration.

abilities.name: Sugar Rush
abilities.description: Eating a waffle increases health regeneration by %2$s%% for %3$s seconds; the effect stacks. There's a %1$s%% chance the waffle won't be consumed.

relics.name: Bustling Fungus
relics.description: Heal all nearby allies after standing still for 1.5 seconds.
relics.note: Heals 6% to 46% of max health per second in an area while standing still.

abilities.name: Healthy Fungus
abilities.description: After the holder remains stationary for 1.5 seconds, the item creates a radius of 2.5m which heals any ally within for %1$s%% health every second, as long as the holder remains still

relics.name: Chromatic Cloak
relics.description: A stylish and vibrant cloak, woven from the wool of a mythical rainbow sheep...
relics.note: Color Focus raises potion effect levels up to 14 at max, so its top end stays at Mythic.

abilities.name: Spectrum Magic
abilities.description: Stores up to %1$s slots of wool with up to %2$s units each. Every wool color grants a specific effect, applied for %3$s seconds if not already active, consuming one unit of wool. To insert wool, right-click the cloak in inventory with wool; to extract, make sure the cursor holds no item.

abilities.name: Color Focus
abilities.description: Increases the effect level based on the number of identical-colored wool slots, up to a maximum level of %1$s.

relics.name: Cicada in a Bottle
relics.description: A jar filled with the energy of hatred. Though this spawn of evil looks like a small bug, do not let your eyes deceive you. Its devilish song can evoke true rage in anyone who hears it, making them willing to do anything to make it stop.
relics.note: Turns nearby mobs against the cursed target.

abilities.name: Cicada's Curse
abilities.description: Has a %1$s%% chance on hit to inflict the Cicada's Curse on the target for %2$s seconds, forcing all nearby mobs to attack that target, ignoring their other tasks.

relics.name: Crown of the Legend
relics.description: This crown embodies courage. Those who wear it inherit the legacy of a true legend, unshaken in the face of any challenge.
relics.note: Life steal on missing health is the stronger half.

abilities.name: King Pig
abilities.description: Increases your damage against pig based mobs by %1$sX.

abilities.name: Not Even Close
abilities.description:
Grants life-steal scaling with damage and missing health.
(1-(Current Health)/(Maximum Health)) * Damage * %1$s

relics.name: Epoch Apple
relics.description: An ancient apple believed to be from the earliest generations of its kind. Its regenerative abilities allow it to recover from severe damage which is how it has survived through the ages.
relics.note: A golden apple that regrows. Ripen adds Fire Resistance and Resistance like an enchanted apple.

abilities.name: Persistent
abilities.description: The apple recovers to its full form after %1$s minutes of being eaten.

abilities.name: Ripen
abilities.description: The apple ripens into greater quality after %1$s minutes of being in its full form.

relics.name: Fading Rust
relics.description: It glows brighter as you fade.
relics.note: Terminux. Spells cost less mana the more health is missing, about 30% at most.

abilities.name: Desperation
abilities.description: Spells cost %1$s%% less mana for every 10%% of your missing health.

relics.name: Frost Relic
relics.description: Killing enemies surrounds you with an ice storm.
relics.note: Ice storm on kill, 120% up to 250% base damage per second.

abilities.name: Ice Storm
abilities.description: Killing an enemy surrounds you with an ice storm that deals %1$s%% of base damage per second and slows enemies for 1.5s. The storm grows with every kill, increasing its radius by 2m. Stacks up to %2$sm

relics.name: Gilded Horseshoe
relics.description: Hung the right way up, for once.
relics.note: Terminux trinket, Uncommon. Luck, which Apotheosis reads for affix rarity and gem purity.

abilities.name: Fortune
abilities.description: Increases luck by %1$s. Luck improves affix rarity and gem purity rolls.

relics.name: Glutton's Charm
relics.description: Never full. Never satisfied.
relics.note: Terminux trinket, Uncommon. Faster eating; meals give attack speed and mana.

abilities.name: Big Appetite
abilities.description: You eat %1$s%% faster.

abilities.name: Feast
abilities.description: Each meal grants %1$s%% attack speed and %2$s mana per point of nourishment; the attack speed lasts %3$s seconds.

relics.name: Goblin Nose
relics.description: A nose crudely taken from a goblin. No one suspected that goblins could shed skin like lizards...
relics.note: Ore sense.

abilities.name: Goblin Sense
abilities.description: When activated, worsens vision but enhances smell, allowing the detection of valuable ores within a %1$s block radius. Also allows storing up to %2$s ore blocks inside the nose, so the sense only recognizes them. To store ore, right-click the nose in the inventory with it. To extract ore, the cursor must be empty.

relics.name: Gravitum Strider
relics.description: A boot that uses a Gravitum engine to reduce the effects of gravity. It was commonly used by astronauts for training before the severe health risks of Gravitum were discovered.
relics.note: Lower gravity early, Leap later.

abilities.name: Elevated Steps
abilities.description: Reduces your gravity by %1$s%. Fall damage and safe fall distance are adjusted accordingly.

abilities.name: Leap
abilities.description: Jumping after crouching for one second launches you upwards with a force of %1$s. You take reduced fall damage from this jump.

relics.name: Guts Orb
relics.description: A flawless orb with stark white corners, its center a deep purple that seems to pulse with a quiet, simmering anger. It radiates an unsettling aura, as if it harbors a grudge.
relics.note: Extra damage while debuffed or burning.

abilities.name: Guts
abilities.description: If you are under a negative effect or on fire, deal %1$sX extra damage.

relics.name: Holy Locket
relics.description: Grants the wearer the ability to turn enemies' healing against them.
relics.note: Ascension, a stacking immortality on kill, opens at Epic.

abilities.name: Faith
abilities.description: Has 2 toggleable modes: Holiness and Unholiness. In the red Holiness mode, steals %1$s%% of the healing from visible entities within a radius of %3$s blocks and transfers it to the relic's wearer. In the blue Unholiness mode, deals damage to all visible entities within the same radius equal to %2$s%% of the healing received by the relic's wearer.

abilities.name: Penitence
abilities.description: Ignites undead enemies for 10 seconds and increases damage dealt to them by %1$s%%.

abilities.name: Ascension
abilities.description: Killing a target grants the relic's wearer a temporary stacking immortality effect for %2$s seconds, up to a maximum of %1$s seconds.

relics.name: Hungering Heart
relics.description: It beats faster with every spell.
relics.note: Terminux. Spell life steal for a little spell damage, plus max mana.

abilities.name: Hunger
abilities.description: Spells heal you for %1$s%% of the damage they deal, but deal %2$s%% less damage.

abilities.name: Heart Well
abilities.description: Increases max mana by %1$s%%.

relics.name: Irradiant Pearl
relics.description: Increase all of your stats.
relics.note: Raises many attributes, max health included, by 2% up to 20%.

abilities.name: 1-UP
abilities.description: Increases most player stats by %1$s%%

relics.name: Leyweave Cloak
relics.description: Woven from ley lines, it gives back what the world takes.
relics.note: Terminux. Damage taken refills mana; healing from spent mana opens at Rare.

abilities.name: Mana Tide
abilities.description: Taking damage restores mana equal to %1$s%% of the damage taken.

abilities.name: Life Tap
abilities.description: Spending mana heals you for %1$s%% of the mana spent.

relics.name: Mana Edge
relics.description: Every cut draws a little magic back.
relics.note: Terminux. Melee hits refill mana; missing mana raises melee damage. A bridge for melee and magic builds.

abilities.name: Mana Strike
abilities.description: Dealing melee damage restores mana equal to %1$s%% of the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Empty Vessel
abilities.description: Melee damage increases with your missing mana, up to %1$s%% when your mana is empty. Does not work with blood magic.

relics.name: Mana Syringe
relics.description: Clearly labeled this time.
relics.note: Terminux. Emergency mana refill below 20% mana; the second ability shortens the 120 second cooldown to 60.

abilities.name: Emergency Dose
abilities.description: When your mana drops below 20%%, restores %1$s%% of your max mana over 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Quick Refill
abilities.description: Emergency Dose can trigger again after %1$s seconds.

relics.name: Midnight Robe
relics.description: +1 experience point for every 2 units of damage when attacking while being invisible from the «Disappearing» ability.
relics.note: Invisibility in the dark first, the strong opening hit later.

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.description: Grants the wearer complete invisibility and increases their movement speed by %2$s%% when the total light level does not exceed %1$s.

abilities.name: Betrayal
abilities.description: An attack while using the 'Vanish' ability deals %1$s%% increased damage, marking a circle with a radius of %2$s blocks around the target and dispelling the wearer's invisibility. The 'Vanish' ability can only be used again after the wearer exits the circle.

relics.name: Minotaur Hoof
relics.description: The hoof of a beast that guarded the heart of the underground labyrinth. Rumored to grant its wearer the speed and endurance of the frenzied minotaurs.
relics.note: Sprint speed up to +130% and damage reduction up to 67.5% while charging.

abilities.name: Stampede
abilities.description: While sprinting, gradually increases the player's movement speed up to %1$s%%. After 3 seconds of running, once the player reaches maximum speed, incoming damage is reduced by %2$s%%, and all nearby targets are knocked back and take %3$s damage until the player stops running.

relics.name: Moodworm
relics.description: A symbiotic worm that manipulates its host's emotions, helping them adapt and thrive in shifting conditions.
relics.note: Tranquillity, all moods at once, opens at Epic.

abilities.name: Moody
abilities.description:
The worm changes its mood every 10 minutes, providing different benefits:
Furious: Increases damage by %1$sX and attacks burn enemies.
Joyful: Increases speed and luck by %1$sX.
Gloomy: Reduces damage taken by %2$s% and increases resistance to knockback.

abilities.name: Tranquillity
abilities.description:
The worm can switch to a new mood.
Tranquil: Provides all the advantages of the worm's other moods.

relics.name: Opal Necklace
relics.description: A silver necklace adorned with a small opal stone, traditionally gifted to travelers and soldiers venturing into barren lands, symbolizing a wish for their safety and protection.
relics.note: Blocks all damage once every 160 down to 60 seconds.

abilities.name: Bubble Shield
abilities.description: Protects from all damage once, then goes on cooldown for %1$s seconds.

relics.name: Parasite 115
relics.description: ...deep within the prison chambers of the §kDark§r Tower, inmate number 115 was forcibly infected with an unknown §kparasite§r. The §klarva§r entwined with his body, feeding on his §kmind§r and flesh until only a twisted mass of reddish §krot§r remained. The warped minds of the wardens immediately forced the §kunfortunate soul§r from the neighboring cell to taste the result. He resisted, but once a piece touched his tongue...
relics.note: Infection with delayed strikes.

abilities.name: Invasion
abilities.description: Has a %1$s%% chance to infect the attacked target with a parasite, which, if the target is not attacked again within 5 seconds, delivers %2$s rapid strikes dealing %3$s damage each. If the target is killed by the parasite's attack, a random amount of §kExperiment 115§r will drop, up to %4$s units.

relics.name: Rage Glove
relics.description:
+1 experience point for every 3 charges from the ability «Berserker Rage» when they are reset.
+1 experience point for each target hit by the «Spurt» ability.
relics.note: Each skill opens one rarity after the previous one.

abilities.name: Berserker Rage
abilities.description: Each attack made by the wearer within %3$s seconds of the last one accumulates 1 charge in the relic's internal buffer. The player's damage increases by %2$s%% per charge, but they also take %1$s%% more damage. If the player fails to attack within the given time to gain another charge, the relic's internal buffer is completely emptied, nullifying all accumulated bonuses.

abilities.name: Phlebotomy
abilities.description: Increases the player's attack speed by %3$s%% and movement speed by %2$s%%, while also granting passive health regeneration of %1$s% per missing percent of the player's health.

abilities.name: Spurt
abilities.description: When activated, performs a dash in the direction of the player's gaze up to %2$s blocks, igniting, inflicting bleeding, and attacking every target in its path with the item in hand. Deals additional damage to each target equal to %1$s per charge stored in the relic's internal buffer from the «Berserker's Rage» ability and then empties it, before going on cooldown for %3$s seconds.

relics.name: Reflecting Necklace
relics.description: +1 experience point for every 10 damage accumulated in the internal buffer of the relic from the ability «Infernal Hatred».
relics.note: Stores damage taken and explodes into shards.

abilities.name: Infernal Hatred
abilities.description: Accumulates damage taken by the wearer into the relic's internal buffer, with a capacity of %1$s units. Five seconds after the last damage received or if the buffer overflows, the relic explodes, scattering obsidian shards in all directions. Each shard deals %2$s damage and stuns for %3$s seconds per unit of damage stored in the relic's internal buffer.

relics.name: Runic Plate
relics.description: A rune-carved plate forged by Stafir of the legendary twin smiths. It is said to be able to block not just physical blows, but fate itself.
relics.note: Pairs with the Swiftedge.

abilities.name: Head Start
abilities.description:
Upon entering combat, the damage of the first %2$s attacks you take is reduced by %1$s%.

You are considered out of combat if you haven't dealt or taken damage for 15 seconds.

abilities.name: Peaceland
abilities.description: You restore %1$s health per second while out of combat. This healing can overheal you up to %2$s health.

abilities.name: Blood Bond
abilities.description: If you also have Swiftedge equipped, Head Start's boosted attack count is increased by 50%.

relics.name: Scaled Cloak
relics.description: A cloak woven from giant serpent scales not only takes on the shape of its previous owner but also inherits some of her abilities.
relics.note: Wall climbing early; the miss chance passes 100% at max, so its top end stays at Mythic.

abilities.name: Grip
abilities.description: Allows the player to smoothly climb walls for %1$s seconds. After the duration ends, the player will slowly slide down.

abilities.name: Elusive Stare
abilities.description: When taking damage, has a %1$s%% chance to make the attacker miss if the player maintains eye contact with them.

relics.name: Sentient Rust
relics.description: A cluster of Ferro Comedenti fungi, a rare species of fungus which rapidly corrodes metal on contact. Commonly known as 'Sentient Rust' for its reddish hue.
relics.note: Stacking armor corrosion, up to -50% armor.

abilities.name: Corrosive
abilities.description: Applies an armor-corroding effect for %1$s seconds. Consecutive hits refresh the duration and stack the effect (up to 10 times). Each stack reduces armor by %5.

relics.name: Shieldweave Cape
relics.description: A cape woven with steel-like threads that adjust to the wearer's armor, covering weak spots.
relics.note: Block chance up to 33% and bonus armor.

abilities.name: Impact Shield
abilities.description: The cape hardens upon impact, blocking the hit with %1$s% + %2$s% * armor chance (max 33%).

abilities.name: Dynamic Thread
abilities.description: The cape covers your weak spots, increasing your armor by %1$s%.

relics.name: Slumbering Amulet
relics.description: A simple, unremarkable necklace lacking distinction, yet something about it feels off as if it were destined for a greater purpose.
relics.note: Dormant. Awakens with a Nether Star into the Whispering Amulet; awakening opens at Epic.

abilities.name: Odd Aura
abilities.description: This relic brings a soothing comfort, making you feel compelled to wear it more.

abilities.name: Awakening Potential
abilities.description: While wearing the amulet, thoughts of Nether Stars fill your mind, and visions of them appear in your dreams. A strong urge to hold one begins to rise within you.

relics.name: Space Dissector
relics.description: +1 experience point for each created portal if there is no existing one
relics.note: Linked portals.

abilities.name: Dissection
abilities.description: Holding RMB creates a portal at a point along the line of sight. Releasing RMB within a distance of %1$s blocks creates a second portal in the same way, linking it to the first. When a living entity approaches a portal, it is teleported to the linked portal. Portals do not function if impassable blocks are in their way. After %2$s seconds, the portals close and disappear.

relics.name: Spore Sack
relics.description: A simple burlap sack filled to the brim with deadly miasma.
relics.note: Homing spores at low health, damage based on missing health.

abilities.name: Spore Mist
abilities.description: When the player's health drops below 50%, releases up to %1$s homing spores around them. These spores deal damage equal to %2$s%% of the player's missing health and block healing for affected targets for 5 seconds. The ability can trigger again once the player's health rises above 50%.

relics.name: Steel Cape
relics.description: A remarkably flexible yet durable material forms the basis of this cape, providing not only protection for its wearer but also retaliation when their safety is threatened.
relics.note: Flat damage reduction and a stunning steel orb.

abilities.name: Invulnerability
abilities.description: When taking damage that could potentially be mitigated by armor (even if none is equipped), reduces it by %1$s points. If the damage is not fully blocked, there is a %2$s%% chance to launch a steel orb toward the attacker, dealing %3$s damage to all in its path and stunning them for %4$s seconds.

relics.name: Swiftedge
relics.description: A magic-infused blade forged by Magna of the legendary twin smiths. It is said to be sharp enough to split the wind itself.
relics.note: Pairs with the Runic Plate.

abilities.name: Head Start
abilities.description:
Upon entering combat, the damage of your first %2$s attacks is increased by %1$sX.

You are considered out of combat if you haven't dealt or taken damage for 15 seconds.

abilities.name: Modal Soul
abilities.description: You gain a %1$sX speed boost while out of combat.

abilities.name: Blood Bond
abilities.description: If you also have Runic Plate equipped, Head Start's boosted attack count is increased by 50%.

relics.name: Thermoseismic Heart
relics.description: A high-tech heart implant that converts movement and vibrations into energy, powering itself and recharging its internal batteries.
relics.note: Explosion immunity early, the fire blast and Cyberpsychosis later.

abilities.name: Pyromania
abilities.description: Explosions do not harm the user and instead grant a stack of Overload for %1$s seconds, with a maximum of 4 stacks.

abilities.name: Thermal Discharge
abilities.description:
When activated, it releases a stream of heat in a %1$s block radius, dealing %2$s damage. Stacks of Overload are consumed to amplify the fire's power and range.
While cyberpsychosis is active: The fire triggers as if the user has 2 Overload stacks when they have less and the Overload stacks are not consumed.

abilities.name: Cyberpsychosis
abilities.description:
Killing an enemy has a %1$s% chance to trigger cyberpsychosis for %2$s seconds.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.

relics.name: Ukulele
relics.description: ...and his music was electric.
relics.note: Chain lightning grows from 4 to 19 targets and 50% to 100% damage.

abilities.name: Lightning Chain
abilities.description: When hitting someone, there is a %1$s%% chance to create chain lightning that hits up to %2$s other targets within a %3$sm radius, dealing %4$s%% total damage to each

relics.name: Unlabeled Syringe
relics.description: Should you really use it?
relics.note: Trades one Curios slot for one or two slots of another type.

abilities.name: Mutation
abilities.description: The holder acquires +%1$s additional limbs in exchange for 1 other limb

relics.name: Vacuum Glove
relics.description: One of the filthiest tools, not wielded by warriors or mages, but by 'butchers'. Its aura liquefies the air around it, hindering both movement and mind.
relics.note: Slows targets leaving an area around you.

abilities.name: The Edge
abilities.description: Creates an area around the player with a radius of %2$s blocks that slows all targets trying to escape it by %1$s%% at the edge. The slowdown increases the closer a target is to the boundary.

relics.name: VertebraX
relics.description: A high-tech spine implant designed to boost immunity by continuously injecting poison into the body... It was quickly banned and pulled from the market due to obvious reasons.
relics.note: The poison is part of the relic; turning it into Regeneration opens at Rare.

abilities.name: Inoculation
abilities.description: Continuously applies poison while equipped.

abilities.name: Fortification
abilities.description:
Harmful potion effects have their duration reduced by %1$s%. These effects have a %2$s% chance to be filtered, decreasing their level or reducing duration by an additional 20% if the level is already at its minimum. Filtration also synthesizes the opposite beneficial effect for half the original duration if it exists.
While cyberpsychosis is active: Synthesized effects are more powerful and the reduction is amplified by 50%.

abilities.name: Acquired Immunity
abilities.description: Completely converts Poison into Regeneration for its full duration.

abilities.name: Cyberpsychosis
abilities.description:
Killing an enemy has a %1$s% chance to trigger Cyberpsychosis for %2$s seconds.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.

relics.name: Void Bubble
relics.description: A fragile yet durable device that protects the head, body, and mind all at once.
relics.note: No air needed, blocks 3 up to 8 attacks.

abilities.name: Protective Bubble
abilities.description: Encases the player's head in a protective bubble, completely eliminating the need for air. The bubble also blocks up to %1$s incoming attacks before exploding, scattering %2$s shards in all directions, each dealing %3$s damage. It then regenerates after %4$s seconds.

relics.name: Weavers Spool
relics.description: Restored to its former power, the spool now regenerates silk that can subtly alter reality, weaving outcomes according to the weaver’s design.
relics.note: Each silk skill opens at its own rarity.

abilities.name: Weaver
abilities.description:
Each strike against an enemy weaves silk back into your spool, building up to a maximum of 10 silk stored.
Additionally, gain silk passively every %1$s seconds when you have less than 3 silk.

abilities.name: Bind
abilities.description: Consumes 6 silk to heal for %1$s and grants absorption for a short duration, shielding you from further harm.

abilities.name: Soar
abilities.description: Consumes 3 silk to propel you in the direction you're facing with a force of %1$s and grants a speed boost for %2$s seconds afterwards.

abilities.name: Unravel
abilities.description: Consumes 7 silk to unleash a blast that deals %1$s damage and severely slows enemies for %2$s seconds within a 4-block radius around you.

relics.name: Wellspring Crown
relics.description: The deeper the well, the brighter it shines.
relics.note: Terminux. Spell power from max mana, scales with every mana source.

abilities.name: Overflow
abilities.description: Every 100 max mana grants %1$s%% spell power.

relics.name: Whims of Fate
relics.description: A cursed die that draws strength from its wielder's despair and suffering, promising salvation while demanding agony in return.
relics.note: Dice based damage reduction, a 20 cancels the hit.

abilities.name: Just One More Roll
abilities.description: Whenever the user is hit, rolls a 20-sided die. Each number above 1 increases damage reduction by %1$s%. A 20 cancels all damage, a 1 doubles it.

relics.name: Wisp Queen
relics.description: Her court gathers wherever magic lands.
relics.note: Terminux. Spell hits gather wisps for mana regeneration.

abilities.name: Wisp Swarm
abilities.description: Damaging an enemy with a spell gathers a wisp, at most once per second and up to %2$s wisps. Each wisp increases mana regeneration by %1$s%%. Wisps fade 6 seconds after the last one gathered.

relics.name: Arcane Glaive
relics.description: It answers to spells, not to hands.
relics.note: Terminux. Bouncing glaive on spell hits, cooldown based.

abilities.name: Glaive Storm
abilities.description: When a spell hits an enemy, an arcane glaive flies to it and bounces to up to %2$s more enemies. Each hit deals %1$s damage multiplied by that spell's power. Cooldown: %3$s seconds.

relics.name: Axolotl Cream
relics.description: A light pink cream. Enhances healing and smells like strawberries.
relics.note: Doubles or better all healing received, life steal and Bustling Fungus included.

abilities.name: Mend & Moisturize
abilities.description: Increases healing from any source by %1$sX.

relics.name: Charm Backpack
relics.description: A seemingly ordinary backpack, yet for some unknown reason, charms inside it behave differently...
relics.note: Makes life and keeping charms reusable. Charm slots grow from 3 to 13.

abilities.name: Charm Storage
abilities.description: Allows storing up to %1$s life or inventory charms inside the backpack. When a charm activates, it prevents complete destruction and instead goes on cooldown for %2$s minutes per its level. To store a charm, right-click on the backpack in the inventory with it. To extract a charm, the cursor must be empty.

relics.name: Converging Orb
relics.description: A rather heavy orb made from an unknown material which permanently compresses under pressure.
relics.note: Grows denser with every hit taken; the final task is surviving a Warden sonic boom. Evolves into Wonder of U, allowed only at Mythic.

abilities.name: Convergence
abilities.description: Every time the user is hit the orb undergoes permanent compression, decreasing its size and dramatically increasing its density.

relics.name: Elytra Booster
relics.description: +1 experience point for every 10 seconds of burning fuel when placing it in the internal buffer of the relic from the ability «Acceleration».
relics.note: Fuel powered elytra speed up to 48 blocks per second.

abilities.name: Acceleration
abilities.description: Using any combustible fuel that would work in a furnace on the relic in the inventory replenishes its internal buffer, which has a maximum capacity of %1$s units. Activating the ability while flying with elytra gradually increases the player's flight speed up to %2$s blocks per second, consuming fuel from the internal buffer.

relics.name: Giant's Glove
relics.description: A piece of gear once worn by fairy-tale giants who dwell in cloud-top huts. It's said the only way to reach them is with magic beans whose stalk pierces the skies...
relics.note: Held item stats +15% up to +50%.

abilities.name: Giant's Grip
abilities.description: Increases the size and stats of the held item by %1$s%%.

relics.name: Gravitum Glove
relics.description: A glove which is made from a unique cloth-like material which anchors itself to its current position, making it very hard to move. When it collides with an object it transfers a massive amount of energy, creating a powerful impact even at low speed.
relics.note: 1.7x to 2x attack damage at a third of the attack speed.

abilities.name: All In
abilities.description: Multiplies attack damage by %1$sX but reduces attack speed by 66%.

abilities.name: Bonk
abilities.description:
Attacks over 20 damage (before armor) have a %1$s% chance to trigger a heavy strike, dealing 2X damage and inflicting Dazed for %2$s seconds.
Dazed enemies have a chance to miss their attacks.

relics.name: Hydra Heart
relics.description: The most valuable part of the multi-headed fire-breathing serpent that dwells somewhere in the fiery depths of the Twilight Forest. Though its original owner is long dead, the heart still beats, dripping with searing blood.
relics.note: Burning blood pools when hit.

abilities.name: Fiery Blood
abilities.description: When taking damage, has a %1$s%% chance to drop a blood droplet that, upon landing, creates a damaging area for %3$s seconds, dealing %2$s damage to all targets and igniting them for 5 seconds.

relics.name: Leyline Shard
relics.description: It hums louder the longer you stand on it.
relics.note: Terminux trinket, Rare. Standing still stacks spell power; Lingering keeps the stacks a little after moving.

abilities.name: Leyline
abilities.description: Every half second you stand still grants a Leyline stack: %1$s%% spell power each, up to %2$s stacks. Moving clears them.

abilities.name: Lingering
abilities.description: Leyline stacks stay for %1$s seconds after you start moving.

relics.name: Lich Crown
relics.description: The crown of the Twilight Forest’s very own king - the Lich. A symbol of his power and dominance. Legend has it that the true potential of this relic can only be unlocked by uniting all ten gems...
relics.note: Gems open at Rare. Full immortality inside the Twilight Forest only at Mythic.

abilities.name: Bone Pact
abilities.description: All skeletons become friendly towards the player.

abilities.name: Soulbound Gems
abilities.description: Allows the crown to be inlaid with %1$s special gems. Each unique gem unlocks a new ability, while additional gems of the same type increase the level of the corresponding ability. To insert a gem into the crown, right-click it while holding it in your inventory. To remove a gem, ensure your cursor is empty and right-click the crown.

abilities.name: Twilight Sovereign
abilities.description: Grants full immortality within the boundaries of the Twilight Forest.

relics.name: Parasite 116
relics.description: ...suddenly he began to tremble, his body arching as if §ksomething§r inside tried to break free. His eyes turned white, and with a mad roar he attacked a warden, then another, and another... until no one remained in his path. He awoke deep within the §kwilderness§r of the Twilight Forest - wounded, barefoot, covered in blood. Who knows if it was his last meal to blame, or if he is now the victim of a new experiment - §k116§r.
relics.note: Evolved parasite; rage is the stronger half.

abilities.name: Invasion
abilities.description: Has a %1$s%% chance to infect the attacked target with a parasite, which, if the target is not attacked again within 5 seconds, delivers %2$s rapid strikes dealing %3$s damage each. If the target is killed by the parasite's attack, a random amount of §kExperiment 115§r will drop, up to %4$s units.

abilities.name: Rage Consumption
abilities.description: Consuming §kExperiment 115§r restores %1$s%% rage charge, which is consumed at a rate of 10%% per second. Rage increases the player's movement speed, attack speed, and damage. At 100%% rage, the bonus reaches %2$s%%.

relics.name: Platinum Horseshoe
relics.description: Luck is on your side.
relics.note: Rerolls random effects 1 to 6 extra times.

abilities.name: Try again!
abilities.description: All random effects are rolled +%1$s times for a favorable outcome

relics.name: Sanguine Pearl
relics.description: Mana is a habit. Blood is a promise.
relics.note: Terminux. Blood magic: spells cost health, mana regeneration heals. Changes the whole build, so Rare.

abilities.name: Blood Pact
abilities.description: Your mana stays empty and spells cost health instead. A spell that would use 10%% of your max mana takes %2$s%% of your max health. Every 100 max mana grants %1$s%% spell power.

abilities.name: Blood Flow
abilities.description: Your mana regeneration heals you instead, at %1$s%% of its strength.

relics.name: Scouring Eye
relics.description: An eye torn from the socket of one of the legendary End monsters. Despite the years passed, it is still alive and searching for a target for its next battle...
relics.note: Teleports behind the last target.

abilities.name: Pursuit
abilities.description: Remembers the last target attacked by the player for %2$s seconds. When the ability is activated, the player is teleported behind the remembered target and the ability goes on cooldown for %1$s seconds.

relics.name: Shadow Glaive
relics.description: A masterfully forged, capricious weapon. If its temper is favorable, neither horde nor legion will withstand the onslaught of its thousand blades.
relics.note: Bouncing projectiles; cloning them is the stronger half.

abilities.name: Mayhem
abilities.description: Dealing damage has a %1$s%% chance to trigger a projectile that bounces chaotically between nearby targets within a 16-block radius, up to %2$s times, dealing %3$s%% of the triggering attack's damage.

abilities.name: Cloning
abilities.description: Each projectile bounce from the Mayhem ability has a %1$s%% chance to spawn an additional identical projectile.

relics.name: Spellstring Lute
relics.description: Every chord is a spark waiting for a spell.
relics.note: Terminux. Chain lightning on spell hits, cooldown based.

abilities.name: Resonance
abilities.description: When a spell hits an enemy, lightning jumps from it to up to %2$s more enemies within %3$s blocks. Each takes %1$s damage multiplied by that spell's power. Cooldown: %4$s seconds.

relics.name: Tidal Pearl
relics.description: It still feels the pull of the moon.
relics.note: Terminux trinket, Rare. Water and rain give damage and regeneration; a steam shield in the Nether.

abilities.name: Tidal Surge
abilities.description: In water or rain you deal %1$s%% more damage and regenerate %2$s health per second.

abilities.name: Steam Shield
abilities.description: In the Nether you take %1$s%% less damage.

relics.name: Twilight Feather
relics.description: A feather from the tail of a mysterious bird that could transform into other creatures.
relics.note: 1% up to 5% instant execute on targets with no more health than your max health.

abilities.name: Execution
abilities.description: When attacking a target whose current health does not exceed the player's maximum health, there is a %1$s%% chance to instantly execute it, transforming it into a small bird.

relics.name: Twin Fangs
relics.description: A wrist attachment with dual curved blades pointing outward. It is designed to be used alongside a primary weapon, striking the moment the foe's attention is diverted. This unusual style is a favorite among bandits and assassins as it can make even the most seasoned opponents slip up.
relics.note: Two hits per attack, up to 120% total damage, on-hit effects trigger twice.

abilities.name: Two Fold
abilities.description: Divides your attacks into two parts dealing %1$s% and %2$s% of your damage each.

abilities.name: Blindside
abilities.description: Makes it so your attacks cannot be blocked with shields.

relics.name: Twin Mirror
relics.description: Your reflection fights alongside you.
relics.note: Terminux trinket, Rare. Summons share your spell power bonus; a fallen summon gives a shield.

abilities.name: Reflection
abilities.description: Your summons deal extra damage equal to %1$s%% of your spell power bonus.

abilities.name: Mirror Ward
abilities.description: When one of your summons dies, you gain %1$s absorption health. At most once every 5 seconds.

relics.name: Tyrant Mask
relics.description: A brass mask once worn by a forgotten tyrant. Though his soul is long gone the mask still brims with malice, drawing restless spirits and trapping them within its dark influence.
relics.note: Cursed until its tasks are done: hunting, travelling and building. Evolves into King Crimson, allowed only at Mythic.

abilities.name: Regrets
abilities.description: The trapped souls within the mask hinder you, lowering your speed, damage, and attack speed by %1$s%.

abilities.name: Revenge
abilities.description: The souls trapped within the mask crave for revenge against the monsters that slayed them. Perhaps hunting monsters with them could soothe their fury.

abilities.name: Monotony
abilities.description: The souls trapped within the mask regret avoiding change and living a monotonous life. Perhaps travelling with them could soothe their longing for adventure.

abilities.name: Futility
abilities.description: The souls trapped within the mask carry the sorrow of a life spent without leaving a lasting mark. Maybe building with them will help soothe their need to create.

relics.name: Void Cloak
relics.description: A robe belonging to a mage who, according to legend, lived beneath the bedrock of any known world. There he mastered a never-before-seen magic of void runes and defeated a massive End beast, whose eye still roams in search of battle.
relics.note: Void immunity early, void runes and the death zone later.

abilities.name: Invulnerability
abilities.description: Grants complete immunity to void damage.

abilities.name: Call of the Void
abilities.description: Every %1$s seconds, summons a void rune under a random nearby target, dealing %2$s damage.

abilities.name: Final Cry
abilities.description: Upon the death of the player or their controlled creature, summons a seismic zone at the death location with a radius of %1$s blocks, triggering void runes up to %2$s times, each dealing %3$s damage.

relics.name: Void Vortex in a Bottle
relics.description: A homework assignment of a student from the infamous magic school where students face deadly trials, capturing lightning, clouds, or vortexes in jars...
relics.note: Pulling vortex on kill.

abilities.name: Void Tornado
abilities.description: Upon killing a target, summons a void vortex %1$s blocks tall that pulls in nearby targets and goes on cooldown for %3$s seconds. After 5 seconds, the vortex explodes, dealing %2$s damage to all nearby targets. If a weaker or equal vortex is nearby, it absorbs it, growing in size and extending its duration.

relics.name: Mass Gauntlet
relics.description: A gauntlet with a massive iron ball affixed to it, designed to force the user's body to move in sync with their strikes. This unique design amplifies the power of each attack as the user's weight is channeled into every blow.
relics.note: Extra damage equal to 10 to 18% of your max health per hit. With player health up to 20,000 this is huge.

abilities.name: Heavy Hitter
abilities.description: Your attacks deal %1$s% of your maximum health as extra damage with a small cooldown.

relics.name: Phoenix Feather
relics.description: It has burned before. It will burn again.
relics.note: Terminux trinket, Epic. Survive a lethal hit once per cooldown; the second ability adds a fire nova.

abilities.name: Rebirth
abilities.description: When you would die, you survive with %1$s%% of your max health instead. Recharges after %2$s seconds.

abilities.name: Ashen Nova
abilities.description: Rebirth releases a fire nova that deals %1$s damage to enemies within %2$s blocks and sets them on fire.

relics.name: Whispering Amulet
relics.description: Tendrils of pure light unfurl from the amulet, twisting and thrashing with frantic energy as if they are reaching for something just beyond the veil, a place they desperately seek.
relics.note: Guides you to a place where it ascends into Made in Heaven. Ascension allowed only at Mythic.

abilities.name: Together We Will Reach Beyond
abilities.description: The amulet hums softly, its whispers winding through your mind, guiding you toward a place it insists you must go.

relics.name: King Crimson
relics.description: Freed souls burst out of the mask, changing its color and leaving a strange hole in the middle. When you look into the hole you can't see the bottom but the other side looks solid.
relics.note: Executes targets under 22% health and rewinds time. Too strong to split. Only obtained by evolving a Mythic Tyrant Mask.

abilities.name: Epitaph
abilities.description: Distorts time and space, rewinding you to your position from 10 seconds ago. %1$s seconds cooldown.

abilities.name: Talk to The Wind
abilities.description:
Your attacks disrupt your target's mind, applying Weakness and Slowness with a %2$s% chance for %1$s seconds. If the target is another player Static is also applied for half the duration.
Your first attack after Epitaph always triggers this effect.

Static makes players unable to see other mobs and players while it is active.

abilities.name: The Court Of The Crimson King
abilities.description: When you attack, if your maximum health is more than or equal to your target's maximum health and their health is below %1$s%, they are instantly executed. If your target has more maximum health than you they instead take double damage below this threshold.

relics.name: Made in Heaven
relics.description: The amulet has unlocked its full potential, transforming into its true form. It now seems to share a bond with you.
relics.note: All stats up, automatic revive and two strong actives. Only obtained by ascending a Mythic Whispering Amulet.

abilities.name: As One
abilities.description:
Made in Heaven channels its power into you, increasing all your stats by %1$sX.
Hitting an enemy grants Accelerating, stacking up to 10 times. Each stack boosts all stats except health by 0.03X. Gaining stacks has a %2$s second cooldown and all stacks expire after a short duration of not attacking.

abilities.name: Zenith
abilities.description:
While at 10 Accelerating stacks gain an additional %2$sX stat boost and automatically revive with half your maximum HP when you die.
Triggering the revive puts it on cooldown for %1$s seconds and consumes all Accelerating stacks.

abilities.name: Condemn
abilities.description:
Upon activation, unleash holy fire in a cone, dealing %2$s damage, burning enemies and applying Charred for a duration.
Charred causes affected enemies to take 1 extra damage per level from all sources.
Cooldown: %1$s seconds.

abilities.name: Divine Judgement
abilities.description:
Upon activation, rise into the air and after a short delay engulf everything within a 7-block radius in holy fire, dealing up to %1$s damage over 5 seconds in 5 increasing hits and burning enemies. The last 3 hits apply and stack Charred.
You gain 75% damage reduction while casting this ability.
This ability can only be used while you have 10 Accelerating stacks and has a cooldown of %2$s seconds.

relics.name: Wonder of U
relics.description: The orb has collapsed in on itself, becoming a miniature black hole. It now absorbs any harm aimed at its user, redirecting it toward those who oppose them.
relics.note: Damage reflection, debuffs on attackers and up to 16 seconds of full invincibility. Only obtained by evolving a Mythic Converging Orb.

abilities.name: Entropy
abilities.description:
%1$s% of the incoming damage is also dealt to the attacker.

Reflected damage cannot exceed the user's current health.

abilities.name: Flow of Calamity
abilities.description:
When attacked, the attacker suffers a random negative potion effect.
Cooldown: %1$s seconds.

abilities.name: Event Horizon
abilities.description:
Upon activation, the user unleashes a blast that knocks back and stuns nearby enemies.
For the next %1$s seconds, the user enters a state of nullification, gaining complete invincibility and doubling the effects of Entropy and Flow of Calamity. This ability has a cooldown of %2$s seconds.
